# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def decide(observation, memory):
    """Use safety gating, confidence confirmation, hysteretic steering, and bounded reacquisition."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})
    state = memory.get("state", "IDLE")
    scan_direction = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")
    last_steer = memory.get("last_steer")
    steer_age = int(memory.get("steer_age", 0))

    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    distance = observation["target_distance_class"]
    target_confidence = float(observation["target_confidence"])
    identity_confidence = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])
    track_age = int(observation["track_age"])
    lost_steps = int(observation["lost_steps"])
    safety_confidence = float(observation["safety_confidence"])
    closing_risk = float(observation["closing_risk"])
    heading_error = abs(float(observation["heading_error"]))

    if safety_confidence < 0.60 or closing_risk >= 0.75:
        memory.update(state="STOPPED", last_steer=None, steer_age=0)
        return "STOP", 0.99, memory

    confirmed = visible and target_confidence >= 0.55 and identity_confidence >= 0.60
    if not confirmed:
        memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE" if (state in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "VERIFY"} or lost_steps > 0) else "SEARCH"
        if lost_steps <= 1:
            return "STOP", 0.92, memory
        if lost_steps % 3 == 0:
            scan_direction = "SCAN_RIGHT" if scan_direction == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
            memory["scan_direction"] = scan_direction
        return scan_direction, 0.74, memory

    if track_age < 2:
        memory.update(state="VERIFY", last_steer=None, steer_age=0)
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80, memory

    if distance == "near" and heading_error <= 12.0 and abs(bearing) <= 10.0 and identity_confidence >= 0.82:
        memory.update(state="ARRIVED", last_steer=None, steer_age=0)
        return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory

    desired = None
    if bearing < -12.0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        desired = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif bearing > 12.0 and observation["corridor_right"]:
        desired = "VEER_RIGHT"
    elif observation["corridor_center"]:
        desired = "FORWARD"
    elif observation["corridor_left"]:
        desired = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif observation["corridor_right"]:
        desired = "VEER_RIGHT"

    if desired is None:
        memory.update(state="STOPPED", last_steer=None, steer_age=0)
        return "STOP", 0.98, memory

    # Keep a previous turn through small bearing changes; reverse only for a strong correction.
    if (
        desired in {"VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"}
        and last_steer in {"VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"}
        and desired != last_steer
        and abs(bearing) < 24.0
        and steer_age < 3
    ):
        desired = last_steer

    if desired in {"VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"}:
        if desired == last_steer:
            steer_age += 1
        else:
            steer_age = 1
        memory["last_steer"] = desired
    else:
        memory["last_steer"] = None
        steer_age = 0

    memory.update(state="APPROACH", steer_age=steer_age)
    confidence = 0.91 if desired == "FORWARD" else (0.88 if abs(bearing) > 12.0 else 0.82)
    return desired, confidence, memory
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
